profile_text.body:
Deere & Co is a public company headquartered in Moline, Illinois, trading under the ticker DE. Its website presents John Deere as a provider of agricultural, construction, and forestry machinery, along with technology and services, and directs visitors to find a dealer or purchase online.

The harvested site text does not describe any specific AI products, and no products or MCP servers are recorded for the company. The available material covers its machinery and equipment business rather than an AI offering.

The company's recorded facts include a CIK of 0000315189 and a law exposure count of 375 in Illinois. No lawsuits are listed.
